_doc: React (Mantine 9 and the components/ui seam) to Slint 1.18. Each rule: `slint` is the element written; `props` maps a JSX prop to the Slint property it sets (a trailing ! negates a bool); every value is converted with the type the Slint element declares (src/slint-types.mjs). `values` lists fixed conversions for a prop's literal values; `fixed` is always written; `gaps` names props with no Slint equivalent and why; `handled` names props the converter turns into structure rather than a property (grid cells, tab state); `text` is the property that takes the element's children as text; `iconChild` takes an icon child as an image property; `wrapping` and `grid` select the flex layouts; `mountWhen` mounts the element only while that prop is true (an `if`); `rust` marks logic for the view model. Mantine's default props (mantine-defaults.json) apply before the source's own. `own` lets a rule replace our own component of that name (otherwise our component converts from its own source). A rule keyed `seam:Tag` or `mantine:Tag` applies only to that import. docs/CONVERSIONS.md is generated from this file.
